summary: Implemented the Team Builder round with canonical `matchPlayers` state, editable role preferences, localStorage-backed saved-player save/load, and preference-rank badges in both candidate previews and the swap editor while keeping the existing 6-candidate and two-click swap flow. `npm test` and `npm run build` pass; optional browser smoke could not be run here because no Chromium-family binary is installed.
completed_work: Added `src/lib/preferences.js` for default preference derivation, unique-order normalization, rank metadata, and summary helpers.
Added `src/lib/playerStore.js` and refactored `src/main.js`/`src/lib/appFlow.js` so pasted players and saved-player loads both hydrate the canonical current-match state.
Extended optimizer/editor data so candidates and editable slots carry preference rank badges and those badges recalculate after candidate selection, preference edits, and slot swaps.

Reworked the UI in `src/lib/render.js` and `src/styles.css` to support Korean-first roster preference editing, saved-player selection/loading, compact candidate summaries, and hidden numeric-score surfaces.

Expanded the fake DOM harness plus automated tests to cover preference logic, player-store persistence, exact-10 saved-player loading, ranking preservation, swap recalculation, and the new UI workflow.
Updated `README.md` and `FINAL_OUTPUT.md` with setup, usage, verification steps, and the documented non-blocking browser/mobile smoke gap.
